summary: Merge startup program added to Sourcey as one entity and one offer, PR #1278.

observations.detail: PR #1278 adds exactly one file, entities/me/merge.yaml, holding one new entity and one offer. The shard directory and file name both derive from the slug 'merge'. sha256 of the file as committed: c711ad33d54179f66de40008b71d3668e152e9b92136c6c31237643bbe9ef945.

The only source cited is https://www.merge.dev/offers/startup-program, a page on the vendor's own domain. Offer: $2,000 in Merge Gateway credits, $5,000 off Merge Unified, and a dedicated solutions architect. Eligibility: Approved venture-backed startups; the offer applies upon approval.
Both required checks are green on the pull request head: 'sourcey/validation' success and 'validate catalog change' success. The commit carries a DCO Signed-off-by line matching the commit author.

The pinned Catalog Verifier was run locally before pushing: 'sourcey-catalog-verify validate startup-credits' reports 'Sourcey verification passed (entities: 1, programs: 0, offers: 1)' against the repository root set and the live parent release.
